name: yardimci-asistan
description: Küçük işletmeler için local-first Yardımcı Asistan monorepo iskeleti.

scripts.build: npm run build:packages && npm run build:apps
scripts.build:apps: npm run build -w @yardimci-asistan/demo-web && npm run build -w @yardimci-asistan/desktop-app && npm run build -w @yardimci-asistan/android-app
scripts.build:packages: npm run build -w @yardimci-asistan/shared && npm run build -w @yardimci-asistan/whatsapp-bridge && npm run build -w @yardimci-asistan/ai-core && npm run build -w @yardimci-asistan/sync-core && npm run build -w @yardimci-asistan/web-widget
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run build && npm run e2e
scripts.check:linux: npm run doctor && npm run lint:php && npm run pack:web-module && npm run smoke:local-lab && npm run smoke:web-form-api && npm run smoke:web-module && npm run smoke:automatic-sync && npm run smoke:web-widget-branding && npm run smoke:web-widget-module && npm run smoke:demo-web-widget && npm run check && npm run smoke:android-hosting && npm run smoke:demo-flow && npm run smoke:desktop-renderer && npm run smoke:desktop-lock && npm run smoke:desktop-package && npm run smoke:desktop:linux
scripts.smoke:reports: npm run build -w @yardimci-asistan/sync-core && npm run build -w @yardimci-asistan/desktop-app && node scripts/smoke-reports-db.mjs
scripts.smoke:record-deletions: npm run build -w @yardimci-asistan/sync-core && npm run build -w @yardimci-asistan/desktop-app && node scripts/smoke-record-deletions.mjs
scripts.smoke:automatic-sync: npm run build -w @yardimci-asistan/sync-core && npm run build -w @yardimci-asistan/desktop-app && node scripts/smoke-automatic-sync.mjs
scripts.smoke:demo-flow: npm run build -w @yardimci-asistan/sync-core && npm run build -w @yardimci-asistan/desktop-app && node scripts/smoke-demo-flow.mjs
scripts.smoke:desktop:linux: npm run build -w @yardimci-asistan/sync-core && npm run build -w @yardimci-asistan/desktop-app && node scripts/smoke-app-lock.mjs && node scripts/smoke-desktop-menu-db.mjs && node scripts/smoke-record-deletions.mjs && node scripts/smoke-stock-image-import-db.mjs && node scripts/smoke-reports-db.mjs && node scripts/smoke-desktop-xvfb.mjs
scripts.smoke:stock-image-db: npm run build -w @yardimci-asistan/sync-core && npm run build -w @yardimci-asistan/desktop-app && node scripts/smoke-stock-image-import-db.mjs
scripts.pack:desktop:dir: npm run build -w @yardimci-asistan/desktop-app && npm run pack:dir -w @yardimci-asistan/desktop-app
scripts.pack:desktop:win: npm run build -w @yardimci-asistan/desktop-app && npm run pack:win -w @yardimci-asistan/desktop-app
scripts.pack:desktop:win32: npm run build -w @yardimci-asistan/desktop-app && npm run pack:win32 -w @yardimci-asistan/desktop-app
scripts.pack:desktop:linux: npm run build -w @yardimci-asistan/desktop-app && npm run pack:linux -w @yardimci-asistan/desktop-app
